opening.argument: The speaker promotes Forsage's newly added matrix as an income opportunity, claiming, “From the morning till now, I have earned 83 BUSD and 5.737 BNB from the system so far.” He further attributes extraordinary daily returns to the system, saying it can give “1 lakh, 2 lakh, 3 lakh, 5 lakhs, 10 lakhs, 20 lakhs, 1 crore per day.” The presentation is tied to matrix-based participation: the dashboard visibly separates Partners and Team panels, while a “For Joining Contact” banner displays a phone number and ID. These extreme earnings claims, recruitment structure, and direct joining prompt together support a deceptive solicitation centered on commissions and tiered participation.
